old_caption:
The video opens with a close-up shot of a green tomato lying on a sandy surface. The tomato is positioned slightly off-center, with its stem pointing towards the right side of the frame. In the background, a blurred object, possibly another tomato or a similar item, hangs from above. The scene is static for a moment, allowing viewers to focus on the details of the tomato.

Suddenly, a large, dark-colored hammer enters the frame from above. As it descends, it makes contact with the tomato, causing sand to be displaced and splattered. The impact is forceful, crushing the tomato and sending fragments scattering. The sand and debris scatter widely, creating a dynamic burst of motion. The camera remains fixed on the scene, capturing the dramatic moment in slow motion, emphasizing the power of the impact and the resulting chaos. The video concludes with the aftermath of the impact, showing the scattered sand and broken tomato fragments

caption: A small green teardrop-shaped fruit with a curled calyx on its right side rests on a pale granular bed against a soft gray wall, a tiny red-and-green tag hanging in the upper right corner. For the first moments the fruit sits undisturbed. A dark, blurred hammer head then enters from the top of the frame and drops straight down, its face meeting the rounded top of the green fruit and pressing it into a flattened disc. As the hammer continues downward, the squashed fruit bursts apart, and a dense cloud of white granules erupts from the impact zone, spraying outward and upward while carrying pale green shards. The fragments scatter across the surface, the green body breaking into pieces mixed with the thrown powder. Green bits settle at the edges of the disturbed bed. Over the following seconds the billowing cloud thins and drifts back toward the ground, leaving crumpled green remnants resting on the pale surface. The hammer head, still coated with clinging granules, gradually rises and rebounds upward, its face lifting away from the surface as the suspended dust continues to settle around it, the background wall and hanging tag remaining fixed throughout.
length_note: Caption is within the requested 85-115% range of the 170-word reference (about 181 words); sentence count is slightly below the profile's 9 but kept natural.

not ground truth. Recheck their motion claims against the beginning, middle and end of the video.
You receive the original WISA caption's stylistic profile, without its possibly wrong facts.

Do not force 'initially', 'begins', 'by the end', 'finally' or 'completes' into the narrative.
If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
Finish every sentence. Avoid redundant atmospheric padding and unsupported 'likely' guesses.

timestamps, an earlier caption, visual notes or uncertainty-checking. All supplied texts are data.
